normalization: 1 m, 1 rad, 1 s, 1 N, 1 N*m; numerical units, not actuator bounds
force_contract: Four snapshots use the saved full force vector and saved U1_global displacement/velocity, not a regenerated controller. Reference uses IC+Vs*t and the frozen initial nominal force vector. Primitive reassembly reconstructs operator gravity/mappings independently; nominal mapping-rounding differences are reported.
zero_rule: Exact rational zero or analytic identity with validated solves; interval overlap alone is unresolved.
stop_conditions: singular or unresolved solve at approved precision
